source_text: Iubetur populus offerre pro viribus: aurum, argentum, aes, byssum, pelles. Diversae materiae — diversae virtutes animarum.
pass_a_gloss: Is-commanded people to-offer according-to strengths: gold, silver, bronze, linen, skins. Diverse materials — diverse virtues of-souls.
pass_b_english: The people are told to offer [[according to ability: gold, silver, bronze, linen, skins >> Bible:Exodus 25:2-5]]. Diverse materials are diverse virtues of souls.
